text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Sirius. I see you're striving forward 
and working diligently every day, as 
always.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I believe you will conquer the world 
without fail. As one who carries the name 
of Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Let me make this clear. I joined Project 
L'Arc for my own sake.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It ain't for "Speed Symboli" or the old 
folks.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...I know. Your approach to the world and 
Speed Symboli's are different."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Even so, I'm proud of it.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Symboli Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Is the old man from Symboli doing well?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Just the other day, I received some 
stern encouragement myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yet they were glad to hear you were doing 
as well as ever. Saying they would have 
loved to rush over themselves—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Haha, thanks. Just hearing you say that 
makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Then, could you pass these words along 
to the old man for me while you're at it?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Yours truly is gonna 'build a bridge to 
the world.'

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...! ...Those are Speed Symboli's words, 
aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
She is the pride of the Symboli family. 
Not only was she the first Japanese 
Umamusume to challenge the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe, but—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
She was the catalyst that brought the 
former Chairwoman, Lady Mejiro, and 
Symboli together. She was the starting 
Umamusume... who paved the way to the 
world.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Fufu, yeah, that's how it was. Ahhh――...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
—She's an Umamusume I've always looked up 
to, as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The outcome of the recent Representative 
Exchange Race gave us a real sense of 
confidence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just about competing against 
overseas Umamusume. That day was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Competing alongside my friends in 
"Project L'Arc" meant the world to me.
choice_data_list: If only I could compete with them again—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...If only we could compete every day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —That view will surely draw closer.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer <username>. You're up quite 
early today.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"Your pelvis movement is still too stiff! 
Don't just run with your knees!"

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>! Could you instruct the girls on 
our team in stretching as well?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Increasing opportunities to hone each 
other's skills, just like in the 
"Representative Exchange Matches"—that 
proposal was accepted by the other 
Trainers as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Making the most of each other's knowledge 
and time, helping one another and growing 
together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—There were things we could only 
accomplish because we were teammates on a 
project sharing the exact same goal.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And there was one more thing: by engaging 
in this initiative, there was something 
they became "deeply aware of."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are many admirable people and 
Umamusume in "Project L'Arc."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Especially if our sights are set on the 
world stage... We must never forget *her* 
presence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The presence I truly, genuinely aspire to 
be like. That is—
choice_data_list: I want to be acknowledged by Mei Satake
Our target is El Condor Pasa
Our target is Tap Dance City

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...When Mei Satake recognized that you 
could become stronger than anyone else."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surely that will be the day we can conquer 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Guess the great me should get to work 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...When you surpass Sirius Symboli, who 
shows more obsession with the world than 
anyone."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surely that will be the day we can conquer 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Guess the great me should get to work 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Always keeping her eyes on the world, 
burning with passion—El Condor Pasa."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps the Goddess of Victory smiles most 
upon an Umamusume like her.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Guess the great me should get to work 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Manhattan Cafe, trying to perceive the 
world more calmly than anyone."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to surpass that quiet madness. 
—That was how I felt.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Guess the great me should get to work 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I have to surpass Nakayama Festa, who 
earnestly desires victory and tirelessly 
puts in the effort.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's no way the day will ever come 
where we could actually win the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Guess the great me should get to work 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Everything Gold Ship does is utterly 
absurd, always in pursuit of whatever's 
"interesting."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That wild unpredictability simply means 
you have more guts than anyone else. Even 
in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, that 
strength will be your weapon."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Guess the great me should get to work 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Even while claiming to be the least 
experienced, Satono Diamond refuses to 
give up."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why we cannot afford to 
lose to her either."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Guess the great me should get to work 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...A whirlwind of fervor and excitement 
always surrounded Tap Dance City.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If star quality is what's required, then 
surpassing her is an absolute must as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Guess the great me should get to work 
too.

Possessing both the might and the tyranny 
of a ruler, the "Tyrant" Orfevre.

If you wish to aim for the world throne, 
you must gain the power to surpass her.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Guess the great me should get to work 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loving "humans," and chasing the romance 
of the "Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe" for the 
sake of "humans"... That is Blast 
Onepiece...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She can challenge everything with all her 
might for someone else's sake... Unless I 
have a resolve that surpasses those strong 
feelings, there will be no victory.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Guess the great me should get to work 
too.

Chrono Genesis's vast knowledge and 
analytical ability regarding racing—born 
from her love of its history— sets her 
completely apart.

"If we can surpass her predictions and 
countermeasures... then we can truly say 
we've taken a step closer to the world 
stage."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Guess the great me should get to work 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beneath her gentle demeanor stands 
Victoire Pisa's heavy, resolute 
determination toward "the world." Facing 
her will be anything but "gentle."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However... only by overcoming such rivals 
can dreams lead all the way to the world 
stage.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Guess the great me should get to work 
too.

...Kiseki is always pursuing thrilling, 
manga-like plotlines to get everyone fired 
up.

When I surpass her and her earnest pursuit 
of greatness... I should be one step 
closer to becoming the protagonist of the 
world's grand story.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Guess the great me should get to work 
too.
